name: Sibmah
brief: Moabite town known for its vineyards
short: Sibmah was a Moabite town known for its vineyards, allotted to the tribe of Reuben (<ref="Num. 32:38; Josh. 13:19">Num. 32:38; Josh. 13:19</ref>) and later mentioned in prophecies concerning Moab (<ref="Isa. 16:8-9; Jer. 48:32">Isa. 16:8-9; Jer. 48:32</ref>).
